# Security Review
1. Draw the data flow: sources of untrusted input, trust boundaries, sinks (DB, shell, filesystem, HTML, network, LLM prompts).
2. For each sink ask: can attacker-controlled data reach it unvalidated?
3. Check authentication and authorization on every entry point, including background jobs and webhooks (verify signatures).
4. Check secrets handling, dependency changes and agent configuration (`forge shield .`).
5. Report exploitable issues with a concrete attack path and fix.
